ward.summary: Chembur (ward M/W) spent ₹46.9 lakh against a ₹44.0 lakh budget, or 107%, so it is over budget. Of 87 jobs, 28% were redone within 30 days, in line with the 24% expected, though ₹11.5 lakh went on repairs that failed. The ward is flood-prone (flood index 0.60), which makes repairs harder to keep in place. Work finished on time in 56% of jobs, better than the 45% expected. Four jobs are listed for review, and 23 jobs worth ₹12.8 lakh were paid on roads under warranty. Next, the ward should fund 26 open issues costing ₹5.0 lakh, starting with RC Marg waterlogging. With ₹0 left, the budget covers none of it, so money must be reallocated or warranty payments recovered.
